meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演主持人，把每个 git worktree、分支或 PR 当作一位参与者，在共享聊天中轮流介绍各自改动、协商冲突，最后输出一份整合计划（包括目标工作树、合并顺序和需要你拍板的决定），但不会直接执行合并。
howto.when: 当用户要求对比多个 git worktree、分支或 PR 并生成整合方案时触发。

say.text: 给这几个分支开个站会，给个合并方案
say.note: Claude 会读取各分支状态并组织对话

say.text: 对比这些 worktree 的改动，整理成一份计划
say.note: 会列出目标分支和合并顺序

say.text: 让这几个 PR 的代表协商怎么整合
say.note: 各 PR 会作为智能体发言

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a facilitator. Each git worktree, branch, or PR joins a shared chat as an agent; they introduce changes, resolve conflicts, and produce one consolidation plan. Claude does not merge anything itself.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to compare multiple git worktrees, branches, or PRs and produce a consolidation plan.

say_en.text: Run a standup for these branches and give me a merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude will read branch states and drive the discussion.

say_en.text: Compare these worktrees and summarize how to consolidate them.
say_en.note: You'll get target branch and merge order.

say_en.text: Have the PR reps negotiate an integration approach.
say_en.note: Each PR joins as an agent.
